tagline: Leading provider of title insurance, settlement services and financial risk solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Title insurance premiums constitute the core of First American's business, directly reflecting its dependence on real estate and mortgage markets, and representing the majority of revenues from the title insurance and services segment

kpis.name: Title insurance premiums
kpis.explanation: Premium revenue from title insurance and escrow services
kpis.description: Title insurance premiums represent the primary revenue of the title insurance and services segment, directly linked to real estate and mortgage market activity. They constitute approximately 65-75% of claims in the first six years following policy issuance.

kpis.name: Reserves for incurred but not reported claims
kpis.explanation: Reserve estimates for title insurance claims incurred but not yet reported
kpis.description: IBNR reserves reflect management's estimate of future claims on issued title insurance policies. A 50 basis point change in loss rates over the last six fiscal years would result in an estimated 162.7 million dollar impact on IBNR reserves.

kpis.name: Loss provision rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage rate applied to title insurance premiums and escrow fees for loss reserves
kpis.description: The loss provision rate is estimated at the beginning of each year and reassessed quarterly. It is applied to title insurance premiums and escrow fees to determine the loss charge recognized in earnings.

kpis.name: Adjusted debt-to-capitalization ratio
kpis.explanation: Non-GAAP financial measure of financial leverage excluding secured financings payable
kpis.description: Non-GAAP measure of First American's leverage that excludes secured financings payable. Provides investors with additional insight into the company's financial leverage.

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt for the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 7.45 billion dollars in the last year

risks.title: Real Estate and Mortgage Market Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The substantial majority of the company's business depends on activity in real estate and mortgage markets. Title insurance claims exposure is sensitive to macroeconomic factors affecting mortgage loan losses, property values, defaults and foreclosures, as disclosed in MD&A Critical Accounting Estimates.

risks.title: Title Insurance Claims Risk
risks.score_rationale: Title insurance policies create long-duration claims exposure. Management estimates that a 50 basis point change in loss rates for recent policy years would result in a 162.7 million dollar impact on IBNR reserves, and 100 basis points would result in 325.4 million dollar impact.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a heavily regulated insurance and financial services industry across multiple jurisdictions in the US and internationally, subject to strict regulatory requirements.

risks.title: Litigation and Regulatory Contingencies
risks.score_rationale: The company faces potential litigation and regulatory contingencies as disclosed in Note 21 of consolidated financial statements.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company maintains and provides access to proprietary title plant databases and real property-related data, requiring robust data security and system protection.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: As a financial and insurance services provider, the company's reputation is critical to customer relationships and regulatory standing.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company provides banking, trust, warehouse lending and mortgage subservicing services, creating exposure to credit risk from borrowers and counterparties.

ai_positioning.summary: First American Financial Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K. However, the company emphasizes digital transformation and automated processes for title and closing services to improve efficiency and customer experience.
evidence: Company utilizes innovative technologies, processes and techniques in production and delivery of products and services
Streamlining title and closing processes by converting certain manual processes into automated ones
